messages.subject: Model averaging
parts:
Dear list members,

I am doing model averaging in unmarked.


modelosoce  <-  fitList(mod1oce, mod2oce, mod3oce, mod4oce, mod5oce, mod6oce, mod7oce, mod8oce, mod9oce, mod10oce, mod11oce, mod12oce, mod13oce, mod14oce)


predict(modelosoce, type="state")


How can I get the coefficients for the model averaging?


Best,

Manuel
